comment: Since worth 2 credits, it was taught as I would expect. Homework every day (not a lot), 10 quizzes, 3 tests. To do well, you must participate, meaning share and raise your hand often. Quizzes/Tests are manageable if you study. In class, don't take mistakes, criticism, or anything personally, just pay attention so you're prepared with what to say.

Dr Torress-Nogales was an amazing professor! She made all her lectures very interesting as well as engaging. She does cold call a lot so you need to be prepared during class but it helps you gain a stronger understanding of the language. Homework is very light and rarely took me over an hour. She is also very funny which lightens the mood.

Loved this class! Very challenging but my Spanish got so much better. She is a great teacher and a very kind person one on one. That being said she can be bluntly critical in class cold calls so just mentally prepare for that.

DO NOT TAKE Torres-Nogales for 306 Spanish in Business. Her reviews for 221 are good, but she was NOT a good 300-level professor at all. we never received any actual grades or assignments back. i swear she was recycling lessons from 221. most disorganized prof i've ever had by far.

I had Torres for 221 and overall she was very passionate and funny during lectures. She does speak in Spanish the whole time and cold calls but don't get down on yourself if you get it wrong. Lots of tests and simple quizzes. Very accessible outside of class. I am not a strong Spanish student at all and ended with a grade I was happy with.

She cold calls. Makes me anxious to come to class sometimes. If you say something that doesn't make sense she visibly acts confused/annoyed. I get embarrassed in this class a lot. Overall, she does want her students to succeed. She is passionate about the language.

Profe is a very kind teacher who cares a lot about her students. Although she is a native Spanish speaker she does not hold any student's performance in the class against them and in fact is very helpful to her students who struggle. She makes a lot of effort to get to know each of her students. 221 is pretty hard but she made it worth it.

Professor Torres is by far the best professor I have ever had at this school. She is the reason I am doing the Spanish minor and I plan to take her again next semester for a 300-level class. The nature of the class is difficult but she makes it very manageable.

I adore this professor! 221 is a class with a lot of content and time spent in the classroom regardless of who you take, but she is so kind and engaging that the class feels a lot less daunting. Her tests and quizzes are always very fair, and she is super accessible for extra help.
Professor Montserrat Torres-Nogales is one of my favorite professors at UR. She is engaging, kind, and made LAIS 221 super fun. I would recommend her class to anyone!
By far my favorite Spanish teacher, always makes class fun and entertaining. Probably my favorite professor I have ever had. If you need to take 221 definitely take her.

Was dreading taking Spanish but she made it so enjoyable. So funny, communicative, and responsive when we are confused. Tough class at a fast pace but she will help out in any way possible and give clear instructions. Also makes Fridays easy with no quizzes bc she knows people go out. Highly recommend her to anyone
Best Spanish teacher I have ever had.
